task_description: Continue the XAUUSD QM/ICT setup automation in the ckrepo validation lab (branch kiro/validation-toolkit). Block 1 (swing + M15 MSS detector, v1_lab/qm_detect.py) is already done and committed (db2c748). Build the remaining objective detectors and the variant-driven rule engine, each deterministic, causal/no-lookahead, with a synthetic self-check AND a real repo-data run. Per the governing anti-overfit rule, every rule the setup creator has NOT confirmed is exposed as a tunable PARAMETER or explicit VARIANT switch (never a pre-picked 'best' value), and variants are A/B-screened on out-of-sample data via the existing v1_lab/pipeline.py. Order: (FEAT-001) NY 8:30/9:30 DST-aware session module w/ IST display [fully objective, first]; (FEAT-002) ERL zone detector + IDM detector w/ cleared test; (FEAT-003) POI/QM zone builder w/ OB/FVG variants + SMT detector w/ rolling-corr guard and honest XAGUSD/DXY data-dependency handling; (FEAT-004) full state machine ERL->SMT->MSS->IDM->POI->M5-confirm->entry/SL/TP with every open rule as a variant switch; (FEAT-005) variant-grid runner producing per-variant trade lists feeding pipeline.py + an honest OOS comparison report. Do NOT push or open PRs; commit locally. Do NOT write verdict/submission entries to the dof_ledger (orchestrator owns those, seq26); report what should be logged. After each block, report what was built, self-check result, real-data numbers, and what remains.

verification.summary: All 8 v1_lab modules byte-compile (py_compile doraise OK). All --selfcheck suites PASS (qm_detect, ny_session, erl_detect, idm_detect, poi_zone, smt_detect, qm_state_machine, variant_runner) - these are the project's test convention (no pytest in the Py3.9 stdlib-only sandbox). Test quality is high: each self-check asserts a POSITIVE case, a NEGATIVE case, and proves a gate/variant is the actual discriminator by toggling it (e.g. IDM cleared-mode wick vs body flips the result; idm_clear_required True vs False flips whether a trade appears; --lookback changes the ERL level; poi qm_fvg suppresses a QM that qm/qm_ob keep), plus explicit causality/no-lookahead assertions (truncate-at-decision-bar yields identical output) and determinism (byte-identical re-run). Real-data run of the top-level variant_runner on XAUUSD_M15+M5 is deterministic (variant_results.csv md5 41a651d5..., VARIANT_REPORT.md md5 adef92ea... on first run; FEAT-005 independently confirmed byte-identical on a second run). Honest OOS outcome: 21 variants, 0 eligible (>=200 OOS trades), 0 PASS - all INSUFFICIENT; no winner declared, exactly as the governing anti-overfit rule requires. docker_build skipped: project is pure-Python stdlib scripts with no build/image step. Not pushed (orchestrator publishes).
verification.honest_result: No variant reached the pipeline's pre-declared 200-OOS-trade bar, so no out-of-sample edge is certified for any variant. This is the expected, legitimate outcome (the engine is selective; ~155 trades over ~12 months). After the review fixes the grid is 25 variants / 24 effective distinct trials, still 0 eligible / 0 PASS / all INSUFFICIENT, no winner declared. Data dependencies for a real verdict: (1) XAGUSD/DXY series to exercise the SMT variant; (2) a longer XAUUSD history and/or forward-collected locked/unseen trades to reach the OOS-trade minimum.
